color.$description: Light theme, same system as dark: shadcn/ui's default theme on the `zinc` base in OKLCH, with Tailwind v4 palette steps for status and content kinds. Light uses the -600/-700 steps where dark uses -400, because a hue that reads on zinc-950 does not read on white.

panel.$description: zinc-50. shadcn `sidebar`: chrome sits a shade off the ground, the inverse of dark.

card.$description: shadcn `card` and `popover`: white, separated by border and shadow rather than by fill.

border.$description: zinc-200. shadcn `border`. 1.27:1 on --bg: decorative separation only, never the sole boundary of a control (see --border-strong).

border-strong.$description: zinc-500. The boundary of an interactive control — input, checkbox, switch track, segmented button. WCAG 1.4.11 wants 3:1 and shadcn's --border is 1.27:1. Measured 4.83 on --bg, 4.62 on --panel, 4.39 on --elevated. Not for dividers.

divider.$description: One step lighter than --border so a region separator never reads as a control edge.

dim.$description: zinc-600, one step darker than shadcn's `muted-foreground`. Secondary text: 7.73 on --bg, 7.02 on --elevated, 6.40 on --selected.

faint.$description: Tertiary text. Off-ramp, between zinc-500 and zinc-600, for the same reason dark's --faint is: zinc-500 measures 4.83 on white but only 4.39 on --elevated and 3.81 on --selected, and this token labels real meta text (A11Y-10). At L=0.5 the worst backdrop measures 4.75.

mute.$description: zinc-400. 2.63:1 on --bg — below AA, deliberately. Decorative only; A11Y-10: never the sole carrier of text.

accent-hover.$description: See the dark theme's note for why the mix goes away from the ink rather than toward the surface. Every light fill takes white ink, so every accent darkens on hover; worst label 6.34 (rose), from 4.78 at rest.

selected.$description: Accent-tinted selection fill. Light takes 12% where dark takes 18% — the same tint over white reads much stronger.

selected-edge.$description: The selection marker: a bar or border at full accent strength. Selection CANNOT be carried by --selected alone — the tinted fill differs from --bg by 1.19-1.27:1 across the six accents and from --hover by almost nothing, so a selected row and a hovered row look alike and neither is distinguishable at WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1. Raising the tint far enough to reach 3:1 makes every selected row a coloured block. The edge measures 3.77 worst against --selected and clears 3:1 against --bg by construction (it is the focus-ring colour). Do not use --border here; it is 1.27:1.

alpha-selected.$description: The accent alpha behind --selected in light.

err.$description: red-600 — shadcn's `destructive` in light, verbatim. 4.91 on --bg.

on-err.$description: Foreground on a solid --err fill: 4.71. White works here because light's --err is red-600; dark's red-400 needs dark ink.

err-hover.$description: As dark's --err-hover, mirrored: the ink is white here, so the hover mixes toward black. 4.71 at rest, 6.23 on hover.

ok-strong.$description: green-800, not green-700: on a 15% --ok tint green-700 measures 4.16 and misses AA. green-800 measures 5.92. A11Y-10 — do NOT merge into --ok, which is correct as a fill and fails as small text.

warn-strong.$description: amber-800. amber-700 measures 4.29 on a 15% --warn tint; this measures 6.04.

err-strong.$description: red-700. 4.90 on a 15% --err tint (destructive ghost button label).

c-url.$description: Content kind: url. cyan-700 — cyan loses the most contrast on white, so it drops two steps.

c-secret.$description: Content kind: secret. rose-700, not rose-600: it also carries the withheld label, and rose-600 measures 4.34 on --elevated.

c-unknown.$description: The closed kind set ends in `unknown`; it falls back to the text-kind colour and never renders blank.

withheld.$description: Fill of the slot where a sensitive item's content would be. See the dark theme's note: the content is absent, so this reads as an empty slot and there is deliberately no blur token.

withheld-fg.$description: The 'Sensitive — activate to reveal' label. 5.80 on --withheld, 5.28 on --selected.
